name: Customize the app
description: A button that starts an agent on this app's own source code, so the app changes the way you want.

permissions.folders:write: Creates the folder named after the app, once.
permissions.tasks:write: Creates a task for each customization.
permissions.agents:spawn: Starts the agent that makes the change.
permissions.workspaces:resolve: Runs agents for that folder in the app's source directory.
